ctaHeading: Newport's concreters are ready — let's pour your project.
aboutText: For over 20 years, Concept Concrete has been Newport's trusted concreting specialist. As registered building practitioners, we provide comprehensive Domestic Building Contracts that protect your rights, covering start and completion dates, warranties, insurance, and termination options. Our team ensures every project, from driveways to exposed aggregate, is completed with precision and care, giving you complete peace of mind throughout the construction process.
servicesText: At Concept Concrete, we provide end-to-end concreting solutions across Melbourne, including Newport. Our services cover residential driveways, exposed aggregate finishes, concrete slabs, thorough site preparation, professional finishing, and detailed consultation with Domestic Building Contracts to meet all regulatory requirements.

services.title: Concrete Driveways
services.desc: We design and install high-quality concrete driveways in Newport, using premium materials and techniques to withstand Australian conditions.

services.title: Exposed Aggregate Concrete
services.desc: Decorative exposed aggregate surfaces that combine aesthetics with long-lasting performance for paths and driveways in your local area.

services.title: Concrete Slabs
services.desc: Precision-poured concrete slabs for foundations, flooring, and various structural needs, tailored to Melbourne's climate.

services.title: Site Preparation & Inspection
services.desc: Thorough site assessment and preparation to ensure a solid base for your concrete project, complying with all standards.

services.title: Finish & Handover
services.desc: Expert finishing techniques and a detailed handover process for complete satisfaction and longevity of your concrete work.

services.title: Consultation & Contracts
services.desc: Guidance on Domestic Building Contracts and project planning with registered building practitioners for legal security.
